# 1 Enoch Chapter 92 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**92:1** This is the book written by Enoch the scribe — the complete instruction of wisdom, praised by all men and a judge of the whole earth — for all my children who shall dwell on the earth and for the last generations who shall observe uprightness and peace.

**92:2** Let not your spirit be troubled because of the times, for the Holy and Great One has appointed days for all things.

**92:3** The righteous one shall rise from sleep, shall arise and walk in the paths of righteousness, and all his paths and his conduct shall be in lasting goodness and grace.

**92:4** He will show grace to the righteous and give him everlasting uprightness, and He will give him authority so that he shall be endowed with goodness and righteousness. And he shall walk in eternal light.

**92:5** And sin shall perish in darkness forever and shall no more be seen from that day forevermore.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. This short chapter functions as the Epistle's prologue and epistolary superscription. LOGOS register adopted throughout — appropriately formal for the opening declaration. V. 1's "complete instruction of wisdom" preferred over EMET's "wisdom-teaching" and PNEUMA's "body of wisdom and instruction." V. 2's "Let not your spirit be troubled" preferred over PNEUMA's "Don't let your heart be disturbed" — the Ge'ez uses ruh (spirit/breath), not lebb (heart). Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
